class.name: TrainDieselElectricEngine
class.brief_description: Diesel engine handler class, for vehicles with an electric transmission (generator + traction motors).
class.description: [TrainDieselElectricEngine] extends [TrainDieselEngine] with the FIZ fields specific to vehicles with [code]EngineType=DieselElectric[/code] (electric transmission). Note that the mechanical-transmission properties inherited from [TrainDieselEngine] (torque converter, retarder, gearbox throttle table) do not apply to this engine type and should be left at their defaults.

members.member: [code]Engine:Flat[/code] Whether the generator's voltage output is capped (flattened characteristic).
[code]Clima:HeatingRPM[/code] Minimum guaranteed engine RPM while heating is enabled.
[code]Engine:AIM[/code] Rate at which the diesel engine's RPM changes.
[code]Engine:ShuntMode[/code] Whether manual generator field-shunting control is available.

[code]Engine:RelayType[/code] Field-shunting relay behavior flag: 0 - current dependent, 1 - velocity dependent, 2 - velocity and power dependent, 41/45/46 - extended variants for specific locomotive types.
[code]WWList[/code] Diesel-electric generator characteristics table. Each item describes a main controller position starting from 0.
